title: SalesForce Development Lead
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

Specializes in planning, designing, and developing software systems (e.g., middleware, legacy, mainframe) and applications from concept phase to series production used in local, networked, cloudbased or internet related computer programs. Developers design, code, test, debug, and document program requirements, working with architects, product managers, and endusers in the development and enhancement of applications. Plans, designs, and develops software systems from concept phase to production in local networks or cloud based related computer programs. Codes in relevant languages. LEAD: Recognized subject matter expert in sub-function typically obtained through advanced education and work experience. Responsibilities typically include:

* Managing large projects or processes and/or products and systems with limited oversight from management.
* Coaching, reviewing and delegating work to lower-level professionals.
* Facing IT function related problems that are difficult and moderately complex.
* Serving as an expert within own discipline

  
  
**About you**

Key Responsibilities

Salesforce Development

* Design, develop and deploy Salesforce solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components and Salesforce Flows.
* Build scalable and maintainable functionality aligned with business requirements.
* In conjunction with the Architecture team, develop reusable components and technical solutions that support long-term platform sustainability.
* Ensure solutions meet security, performance and maintainability requirements.

Solution Delivery

* Work with business analysts and stakeholders to understand and refine requirements.
* Participate in technical design activities and solution reviews.
* Estimate effort, identify risks and contribute to delivery planning.
* Support testing and deployment activities throughout the development lifecycle.

Integration Development

* Work with the Integration team to design and develop integrations between Salesforce and enterprise systems.
* Support integration requirements relating to key broking systems and toolsets.
* Troubleshoot integration failures and implement long-term improvements.
* Ensure integrations meet operational, security and performance requirements.

Production Support

* Investigate and resolve production issues.
* Participate in root cause analysis activities.
* Support warranty, enhancement and maintenance activities.
* Assist with release management and deployment processes.

Development Standards and Governance

* Follow established coding standards and development practices.
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation.
* Participate in peer reviews and quality assurance activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Salesforce practice.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

* Evaluate emerging Salesforce capabilities and identify opportunities for adoption.
* Support the introduction of AI-enabled Salesforce functionality where appropriate.
* Recommend improvements to platform architecture, processes and delivery practices.
* Contribute to the long-term evolution of the Salesforce platform.

Skills and Experience

Required

* Minimum 7 years' Salesforce development experience.
* Strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL and Salesforce architecture.
* Experience developing integrations using APIs and middleware platforms.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce security and data models.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Lead Business Systems Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.

  

**Job Overview**
----------------

Role summary

The Senior Business Systems Analyst carries the analytical execution load of the program. The role works through the detail of the existing learning estate, prepares the analysis that supports rationalisation decisions, and executes the mapping, cleanup and validation activity that follows those decisions. This is a hands-on seat and the volume of detailed work sits here.

Key responsibilities

* Build and maintain the inventory of curricula, learning items, assignments and associated attributes for assigned functional areas.
* Perform detailed analysis to surface duplicates, outdated content, incomplete records, inactive items, dummy entries and administrative accounts.
* Prepare structured analysis packs that allow stakeholders to make migrate, consolidate, archive or retire decisions efficiently.
* Execute data mapping activity between source and target structures, working to the standards agreed for the program.
* Perform and evidence data cleanup and remediation activity ahead of migration.
* Support reconciliation, test execution and user acceptance testing, and capture the associated evidence.
* Maintain trackers, logs, templates and checklists to the standard set by the Lead BSA.
* Prepare recurring status, progress and exception reporting for the assigned functional area.
* Raise data quality concerns, anomalies and emerging risks promptly through the agreed channel.

Required experience

* 8+ years of business analysis, data analysis or systems analysis experience, including involvement in a system transition or data migration.
* Strong practical data-handling capability — comfortable working at volume with spreadsheets, extracts, structured queries and reporting output.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently through detailed, high-volume analytical work with accuracy and consistency.
* Experience preparing documentation, trackers and templates to a standard suitable for a regulated environment.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort operating with stakeholders in a different time zone.
* Willingness to work a dedicated shift pattern providing overlap with US Eastern business hours.
* Experience working within GxP-regulated environments.

Preferred experience

* Exposure to a learning management system, enterprise HR platform or comparable enterprise application.
* Experience in a regulated industry, ideally life sciences or pharmaceutical.
* Experience supporting testing and validation cycles.

Ways of working

* Works to the direction and priorities set by the assigned Client workstream lead or program owner.
* Maintains transparent, timely status against assigned activities and escalates blockers early rather than at the point of impact.
* Documents decisions, actions and open items so that context is held in the program record and not solely with the individual.
* Cross-trains across adjacent functional areas to provide coverage redundancy within the Milestone team.

Compliance and environment

* Works entirely within Client's systems, tools and environments. No client data is moved to, stored in or processed on external tooling without Client's express written approval.
* Operates within a GxP-regulated environment and follows Client's data privacy, data integrity, information security and records-retention standards at all times.
* Completes all Client-mandated onboarding, access provisioning and compliance training before commencing project activity.

Participates in Milestone's structured program induction covering program context, stakeholder map, ways of working and tooling

**Compensation**
----------------

Estimated Pay Range:  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion**
-------------------------------------------

*At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.*  
  
*Milestone Technologies provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law, or local ordinance. Milestone also makes reasonable accommodations for disabled applicants and employees.*  
  
*We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.*
